items.title: RIKEN feature article on AIP's new phase and research aimed at understanding the principles of AI
items.summary_en: A RIKEN 'closeup' feature (original in Japanese) reportedly describes how the Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (AIP), led by Director Masashi Sugiyama, entered a new phase in April 2026, with research aimed at elucidating the principles of AI. Only a search-result snippet was available; the article itself could not be fetched, so details are unverified.
items.notes: Original in Japanese. Date inferred from the URL (20261019), which is before the collection window (2026-11-18 to 2026-11-28). Based on a search snippet only; page fetch failed (DNS block). Include only as background.

items.title: Tokyo Forum 2026 on AI announced for 20-21 November at Yasuda Auditorium
items.summary_en: According to a search-result summary, the University of Tokyo and Korea's Choi Jong-hyun Academy planned a public international symposium on AI for 20-21 November 2026 at Yasuda Auditorium. The reported theme is AI as a transformative technology, touching humans, knowledge and civilization. This is an event announcement, not a research result.
items.source_name: University of Tokyo (DUCR) announcement PDF (via search result)
items.notes: Original in Japanese. The date is the planned event date, not a confirmed publication date. The PDF was not opened, so the details come from a search summary and are unverified. No talk recordings or transcripts were found.

coverage_note: Access failed. Direct fetches of aip.riken.jp, www.riken.jp and www.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp all failed with DNS resolution errors (ENOTFOUND), so these hosts must be added to the session's allowed network domains. This is the third run in a row with this block. The fallback WebSearch queries, in Japanese, found no RIKEN AIP or University of Tokyo AI press releases dated within 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-28. The search tool returned only older material (AIP activity report Jul 2025 to Mar 2026, a MEXT document from May 2026, an October 2026 RIKEN feature) and the Tokyo Forum announcement. The two items above are thin and unverified. This is not evidence that nothing was published, only that nothing was found. A retry is needed once access is allowed. No preprints or peer-reviewed results were collected.
